purpose: Aggregate overlap of observed S&P ticker labels and selected same-period SEC Assets comparisons; no growth targets or returns
threshold_basis: absolute difference divided by earlier filing value
limitations: Exact ticker to observed filing CIK is not verified identity or membership; labels may be retrospective and several share a CIK.
Only selected 10-K pairs in three archives, not a complete filing history; amendments and 10-Q revisions omitted.
This is not a validated universe, fiscal-year mapping, security eligibility, point-in-time availability or accounting comparability.
Current consolidated archives are retrospective and historical publication is unverified.
